title: drypetes lancifolia
intro: Drypetes lancifolia, commonly known as the "Glossy-leafed drypetes" or "Dahon sambal" in some regions, is a species of flowering plant in the family Phyllanthaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its potential to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and treat various skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Drypetes lancifolia include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its medicinal properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions and potential health benefits.
